text:
Great! I found your account, Noah. I can see you have 3 orders on file: #W3445693, #W4219264, and #W6729841.

To help you check how much you paid for a specific order, could you please let me know which order you're interested in? You can either provide the order ID if you have it, or I can show you the details of all your orders to help you identify the right one.
zh:
太好了！Noah，我找到你的账户了。我看到你有 3 个订单记录：#W3445693、#W4219264 和 #W6729841。

为了帮你查一下你付了多少钱，你能告诉我你对哪个订单感兴趣吗？如果你有订单 ID，可以直接提供，或者我可以给你展示所有你的订单详情，帮你找到正确的订单。
